parts.text: A student investigates the image produced by a lens. Fig. 3.1 shows the set-up. Fig. 3.1 Fig. 3.2

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) Fig. 3.2 shows the height h O of the illuminated object. On Fig. 3.2, measure h O . h O = ......................................................... [2]

ms.label: 3(a)
ms.text:
1.6 / 16 as appropriate
matching unit (cm or mm)

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) Fig. 3.1 is drawn to scale. The actual distance u between the illuminated object and the lens is 20.0 cm.

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Calculate the scale ratio r using the equation r = u x , where u = 20.0 cm. r = ......................................................... [1]

parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) The student moves the screen until a focused image is formed on the screen.

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Calculate the actual distance v between the lens and the screen using the equation v = r y . Use your value for r from (b)(ii) . v = ................................................... cm [1]

parts.label: d
parts.text: (d) Calculate the focal length f of the lens using the equation f = uv ( u + v ) . Give your answer to a suitable number of significant figures for this type of experiment. f = ................................................... cm [2]

ms.label: 3(d)
ms.text:
f = 15.1 (cm)
answer is given to 2 or 3 significant figures

ms.label: 3(e)
ms.text:
darkened room / bright object
move screen slowly / back and forth / approach clearest position from both directions (and average)

parts.label: f
parts.text: (f) Fig. 3.2 shows the shape of the illuminated object. The image of the object is enlarged. Draw a diagram to show the image that you would see on the screen. [1]
